Our AWS certified cloud practitioner course is available both online and offline, with personalized coaching available through AWS coaching near you. What is AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner? AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner is for all people who want to start their journey with Cloud services. These courses can be taken by technical as well as non-technical people. It is a stepping stone towards success in your path of career. AWS is a cloud computing service launched by Amazon in 2002. It has its presence in almost all geographical regions. It offers a platform to store data with high-security measures at a cost that cannot be beaten by any other competitors. Also, it is very easy to build scalable and manageable applications using their products. This certification will dive you into understanding the overall working of AWS cloud computing systems. It will help you in understanding how these services can be implemented in your business or for the company where you work. Objectives of this course will be : Learning about the basic features of an AWS system Learning about the best architectural practices Learning about different benefits of AWS cloud Learning about pricing and managing accounts in AWS Learning about the special services offered by AWS Learning about deployment and operations in AWS cloud systems. Pre-requisites You can have 6 months of experience working on some service in the AWS cloud. You may have at least 6 months of working with IT services. AWS Cloud Practitioner Training This training at 3RI Technologies is designed for all, whether it is a fresher or an experienced person from IT services. This is articulated for the holistic development of students keeping a perfect blend of theoretical and practical applications. This will get you ready to soar the heights in this demanding market. It will help you in attaining the due hike which you have been looking for from past some time. An AWS certified Cloud Practitioner can earn Rupees 5 lakhs in India. It also varies with different locations. At 3RI Technologies, we will provide you with in-depth learning making you ready for the industry. Also, we are the leaders among all different training institutes to provide AWS Cloud Practitioner Training with the convenience of students as our priority. What is AWS certified cloud practitioner? An AWS certified cloud practitioner is a recognized coursed accepted by all companies across the globe. This certification will open your ways to Cloud systems. It is for someone who has just started to work on AWS cloud systems. This certification will help you with insights into the Cloud architecture. They will enhance your knowledge about operations and deployment in the AWS cloud environment. You will also learn about the various key services used in the system. This certification will help in demonstrating your overall knowledge about AWS cloud systems. 6. How do I prepare for this AWS certification? It takes in-depth knowledge about AWS systems to clear this course. So, the best way to prepare for AWS certification is to get yourself enrolled in a training course meant for AWS cloud practitioner. This will help you in understanding these concepts from the experts. I would suggest you get yourself enrolled at 3RI Technologies . They are the pioneers in the market for training students and working professionals with AWS. Their training is taken up by certified AWS cloud experts who also have industry experience. Also, their training is accompanied by LIVE projects which are very important for practical knowledge. Also, there is a continuous assessment of the student after the completion of different modules. They can provide you with an online and classroom-based method of training. For an online class, they provide you with the necessary software applications for personal hands-on. The classrooms have well-equipped labs for practical experience on the technology. Also, the instructors at the institute are always available to clarify any doubts, if any. 7. How many hours are needed to become AWS certified? The number of hours needed to prepare to become AWS certified solely depends on the capability and learning desire of an individual. But on average a fresher may need 100-120 hours of dedicated preparation time. Attending AWS Cloud Practitioner training at 3RI Technologies will help you with a guided and practical training approach. 8. Do AWS certifications expire? AWS certifications expire after 3 years. However, by appearing for a recertification exam will activate your certificate again. This will showcase your understanding of the latest developments with AWS. 9. Will enrolling for the course prepare me for AWS Certifications? To prepare for AWS certifications, the first step is to enroll yourself at the best training institutes in Pune, 3RI Technologies. Their training by a team of expert professionals will help you in a proper understanding of the concepts in AWS. Also, a chance to work on LIVE projects with them will help you enhance your practical knowledge. This will prepare you for the AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification exam and also for jobs using AWS services. 10. Will I get a chance to work on a LIVE project in this course? Yes, you will get a chance to work on LIVE projects. As we believe,” Learning without doing ” holds very little importance. Also, our LIVE projects are directly taken from the real industry by our team of trainers who are working with them. This will help you to learn how to handle real-life projects. 11. Do I get a job once I complete this course? We don’t guarantee any jobs. But yes, we have a placement team that will help you with job opportunities. This team will inform you about various job openings that are available. They will also help you in drafting your resume to highlight your new sharpened skills. Also, the AWS Cloud Practitioner course itself will prepare you for an interview taken in any company. And there are a significant number of opportunities available if you are looking for AWS Cloud Practitioner Jobs.
